mode_handling: proof and codeproof are analyzed separately
advantage_mass: for k successes in G attempts, 2*k*(G-k)/(G-1)
rho: one million times total leave-one-out absolute advantage mass divided by actual exported input and output tokens
H: squared total advantage mass divided by the product of specification count and summed squared mass
zero_signal_rule: H equals zero when total advantage mass is zero

cluster_sensitivity.interpretation: descriptive fixed-panel sensitivity, not an independent-specification confidence interval

token_accounting: all actual exported input and output tokens are charged, including final-call usage above the controller stop threshold
